findings.title: The feature-flagged table path discards the query results
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, this branch constructs `TableWidgetVisualization` with `columns: []` and empty `data`/`meta` instead of passing `result.data`, `result.meta`, and the computed fields. Dashboard table widgets therefore render blank for organizations with the flag enabled, regardless of the query response.

findings.title: Error timestamps and breadcrumb timestamps use different time bases
findings.body: The fetched error timestamp comes from the stored event and is an absolute Unix timestamp, while replay breadcrumb timestamps are elapsed replay-relative seconds. Comparing them directly means errors will generally be treated as later than every breadcrumb and appended at the end, rather than interleaved chronologically; the emitted error log also reports the wrong time basis. Convert both values to a common timeline before sorting and comparing.

findings.title: Age/timestamp exclusivity checks accept zero values
findings.body: These validators use truthiness on the other field, so a report containing both `age: 0` and `timestamp: 0` passes validation even though the two formats are mutually exclusive. Check field presence instead; otherwise malformed mixed-format reports are accepted and counted as valid.
